annotation.title_clean: Government response to House of Lords Artificial Intelligence Select Committee's Report on AI in the UK: Ready, Willing and Able?
annotation.title_en: Government response to House of Lords Artificial Intelligence Select Committee's Report on AI in the UK: Ready, Willing and Able?
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UK Department for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy (BEIS); Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport; Office for Artificial Intelligence
annotation.summary_en: June 2018 UK Government response (CM 9645) to the House of Lords AI Select Committee report. It responds recommendation by recommendation, emphasising the AI Sector Deal, Industrial Strategy, new institutions (Office for AI, AI Council, Centre for Data Ethics and Innovation), data trusts, GDPR/Data Protection Act safeguards, skills and procurement, favouring industry-led, light-touch approaches.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates/relies on Office for AI, AI Council and Centre for Data Ethics and Innovation to build trust and guide governance
Data Trusts to enable ethical data sharing for AI
Data Protection Act 2018 provides rights to be informed of and challenge solely automated decisions
Industry-led voluntary mechanisms to inform the public of AI use referred to the AI Council
Public procurement via Digital Marketplace, SBRI and a WEF-linked responsible AI procurement framework
